original_test_intent: Validate PCIe retrain interoperability on the approved HGX path by proving every NVQual Test #27 request follows the authorized training trajectory and returns all expected NVIDIA endpoints at required generation/width and functional health without hang, unplanned reboot, or new errors.
original_method: Pin Test #27, retrain primitive, path/sibling topology, starting and target link state, expected LTSSM/equalization path, settle deadlines, iterations/timing, identity/function and error acceptance; preserve baselines; durably record every request, training transition, settled link, device state and error delta before the next; stop on first fault and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE approves the retrain primitive, path and long-run service impact; an operator isolates the SUT, observes out-of-band health, and owns recovery from a degraded or lost link.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #27 retrain package/configuration and compatible firmware/driver
Starting/target generation and width, retrain primitive, LTSSM/equalization trajectory, settle/transient/deadline rules
Iteration count/timing, full device/function and error acceptance, storage, aborts, final state, and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT with explicit path and retrain authorization
No unsaved workload; verified BMC/console/power recovery; stable cooling/power
Stop on wrong-scope effect, failed/late retrain, marginal/downtrained link, missing/misbound device, driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot, new AER, thermal/power fault, tool failure, or evidence gap
No forced rescan/rebind, reset/power escalation, evidence clearing, or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #27 configuration, topology, baseline, interlocks, ledger, and recovery
Run only the approved retrain primitive
Correlate PCIe, NVIDIA, driver, OS, BMC, console, thermal, and power health
Do not infer target/path, force recovery, retry faults, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #27 recipe, path/sibling scope, iterations, and service impact
Define start/target link, training trajectory, deadline, device/function and error acceptance
Own first-fault disposition and out-of-band recovery
Review every retrain and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies retrain interoperability but supplies no retrain primitive or trajectory; a final lspci/nvidia-smi view cannot prove each request, transition and recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned Test #27 primitive with an atomic ledger and block retrain N+1 until N's request, LTSSM/equalization path, settled generation/width, complete device/function state, timing, and error results are durable.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #27, PCIe Link Retrain interoperability, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/600-minute allocation remain; missing iterations and timing are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL INTERLOCKED HGX PCIE RETRAIN INTEROPERABILITY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each retrain as a path-bound training transaction from approved start state through observable LTSSM/equalization to settled link, identity-complete device/function health, and error acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact path/trajectory, persistent transaction evidence, first-fault inhibition, complete functional acceptance, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A healthy final link cannot reveal skipped requests, failed intermediate states, transient downtraining, identity changes, earlier driver failure, or recovered AER events.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated or misdirected retrains can destabilize a marginal hierarchy, remove GPUs, hang the host, or hide the first failure behind later recovery.

project_override_considerations: A vendor retrain abstraction is acceptable only when the exact link scope and transaction evidence are auditable. Link toggle, SBR, FLR, reboot, and power cycle are not substitutes for a retrain unless separately approved and recorded.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #27 manifest/configuration, and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus complete path/sibling/endpoint/GPU topology
First-fault recovery or clean final topology/link/device/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #27 Procedure, Criteria, and same-row AI review consistently target PCIe retrain interoperability. Missing path and transaction acceptance are readiness under-specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The retrain interoperability objective is clear. Proprietary tooling, path, trajectory, acceptance, isolation, evidence, and recovery are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

review_improvement: Makes every Test #27 retrain a traceable path transaction and rejects later healthy enumeration or reset/power recovery as proof of the original retrain.
independent_technical_reasoning: Retraining preserves the logical device while renegotiating physical link state, so success requires more than endpoint presence. The intended path must traverse an approved training trajectory and settle at full generation/width within deadline while stable identities, driver/GPU function and error state remain acceptable. Since a later retrain can recover a transient fault, transaction evidence must be durable before the next request.
